study_identification_part.si_4_title: Characterizing the distinct imaging phenotypes, clinical behavior, and genetic vulnerability of brain maturational subtypes in mood disorders

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study utilized a single-site dataset from the First Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University, Shenyang, China, consisting of 404 healthy controls for the normative model, and 174 drug-naïve/drug-free patients for the discovery cohort, and 268 medicated patients for the replication cohort.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: We recruited 114 MDD patients, 60 BD patients and 404 healthy controls (HC). All the patients were recruited from ... the First Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University, Shenyang, China. ... To validate the imaging phenotypes, we involved 268 patients who received medication treatment as the replication cohort.

answer.SINGLE-SITE: normative training and testing (HC, n=404); patient for clinical research (Discovery Patients, n=174); validation of subtyping (Replication Patients, n=268)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy controls (n=404) were used to train and test the normative model. Discovery patients (n=174) were used to identify subtypes. Replication patients (n=268) were used for validation.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: The neuroimaging data were from 174 drug-naïve and drug-free patients with MDD/BD and 404 participants as HC; we used quantile regression model and created normative curves ... we then ... examined GMV deviations reproducibility in a replication cohort;

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The normative model was built using 404 healthy controls. The entire HC group was used to create the normative curves.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: we used quantile regression model and created normative curves with age based on GMV in HC group and calculated individual deviations for each region

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The mean age of the 404 HCs was 29.0 years with a standard deviation of 9.3. No separate statistics were provided for train and overall phases, so they are assumed to be identical.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The HC group (N=404) included 244 females (60.4%) and 160 males (39.6%).
